column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 1
It's great that the school trip went off without a hitch, but...
The next question is, just how am I going to give Ayase her souvenir?
Just calling her out would be the easiest way...
Would she really come if I did?
In fact, Ayase was blocking my phone number until just recently.
She finally decided to unblock me after I listened to her troubles on various occasions.
But, wait...
If she unblocked me...
Onii-san, please give me a call, okay?
That has to be it!
Alright, you just wait, Ayase-tan!
...Yes, Aragaki speaking.
Ah, Ayase? It's me!
She hung up?!
...Yes?
Don't just hang up on me like that!
Did you need something?
Of course!
...I see. Actually, there's something I wanted to talk to you about, Onii-san.
Oh? Great timing then.
...Yes.
Ayase didn't sound too enthusiastic.
Could she be worrying about something again?
Or could it be...
A-Are you having some kind of weird fantasies now?
Just for the record, it's not like I'm going to confess to you or anything, Onii-san.
...She's telling me off before I've even opened my mouth.
Well, this time I'm just naturally concerned about Ayase, but...
Regardless of how many events we've had, she's the kind of heroine whose affection level just won't rise.
...W-Why aren't you saying anything?
Sorry. Hmm, I'm not really sure where to begin...
...Then it's probably nothing important, is it?
Ayase, do you... hate me?
Eh...? O-Of course I do.
...Don't you remember... what you've done to me?
...That's right.
Ayase definitely hated me.
However, we've been talking more recently, so I forgot about it.
Well, let me hear you out at least.
I've bought you those oil absorbing sheets you asked for in your mail.
Ah, really? Thank you very much!
Don't mention it.
Great. Seems like Ayase liked it.
I knew it'd be worth my while to get those.
That's all I wanted to say. What did you want to talk about?
Yes, about that...
Um... I... have something that I need to discuss with you, Onii-san.
I see. Leave it to me! You can tell me anything.
Eh? ...Are you sure? You've already agreed... before I even tell you what it is.
You might hate me, but I sure love you.
Eh?!
I'll listen to your troubles any time you want.
N-Now you're just saying nice things again...
Y-You're planning something bad again, aren't you?
I don't know if it's bad or not, but I am planning something.
I-I knew it.
My plan is that by listening to your troubles, I hope I can raise your impression of me at least a little bit.
...Hm, that settles it.
This girl should be completely smitten with me now.
...H-Hmph, you're saying such embarrassing things again...
Huh? That's weird.
Well, guess she isn't that naive.
I wouldn't be troubled over this if such superficial words would improve Ayase's view of me.
...It wasn't a lie though.
Anyway, I'll hear you out.
Yes...
Actually, I feel like Kirino's been rather cold towards me lately...
That's what I thought.
Ayase's concerns always revolve around Kirino.
Alright. Anyway, I want to give you your souvenir from Kyoto, so want to meet up somewhere?
T-Then... at the usual park.
That place, huh...
Whenever Ayase has something to talk about, she calls me to the nearby park.
...There's a police box right on the other side of that park, so it's useless to try and do something to me there, Onii-san.
Hahaha, I wouldn't.
...She sure doesn't trust me, huh.
